parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const headers=$json.headers??{};const analysis=body.request_analysis||body.generated_output||{mode:'credential_ready_dry_run',facts:[],assumptions:[],missing_information:['LLM request analysis not supplied'],risk_flags:[],recommended_outputs:body.requested_outputs||[]};const analysisSql=JSON.stringify(analysis).replace(/'/g,"''");return [{json:{...body,job_id:body.job_id||$json.job_id||"",agent_secret:headers["x-agent-secret"]||headers["X-Agent-Secret"]||"",analysis_sql:analysisSql}}];

parameters.query: =WITH output_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id,output_type,title,structured_data,qa_status) VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'request_analysis','Request Analysis','{{$json.analysis_sql}}'::jsonb,'pending') RETURNING id), job_update AS (UPDATE content_jobs SET status='waiting_for_analysis_approval',updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid RETURNING id), task_update AS (UPDATE content_tasks SET status='completed',updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND task_key='analyse_client_request'), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'request_analysis_completed','Request analysis stored',jsonb_build_object('output_id',(SELECT id FROM output_insert)))) SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM output_insert) AS output_id;
